question: Which surviving CPU readers within the inspected scope prevent treating draw-path dirty, mode, shader-cache and allocator writes as command-only state?

scope.invocationBoundary: Draw entries, commit and their skipped descendants are consumed for those invocations. Setters, getters, creators, Release, reset, Clear, Resolve, tiling, present and title code survive. A helper remains live through a surviving caller.
scope.qualification: Positive static reader links and syntax inventories within the inspected scope. This is not the full set of copied, indexed, rebased, bulk, partial-width, indirect or runtime readers, and does not allow a draw consume.

dependencies.use: Is the source for the writer, persistent patch destination, mode and fence boundaries.
Is the source for API roles, table dispatch and the nine accepted inline dirty writers.
Is the source for the preserved object identities, API aliases and the distinct wider replacement policy.
Is the source for resource-header fences, scratch units, allocator and completion qualifications.
Is the source for list replay, external destinations and unresolved worker aliases.

currentEvidence.method: Serial foreground no-analysis read-only queries through tools/run-headless.ps1. Maintained ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java supplied semantic native words; ghidra/FindDirectCallers.java supplied raw direct-BL inventories within the inspected scope; ghidra/FindGlobalAddressAccesses.java, ghidra/FindSplitConstantCandidates.java and ghidra/DumpReferences.java supplied counter-address leads. Aligned raw-word and generated instruction-comment scans supplied syntactic field candidates; narrow exact-function generated windows supplied register-flow corroboration.

inputQualification.qualification: Fresh sequential comparison confined differences to the historical thunk band. Cited semantic windows avoid it. Regional equivalence does not establish original thunk semantics or whole-image reader absence.

scanBoundary.rawForms: D-form address formation and scalar load and store opcodes 14,32..55 plus DS forms 58/62. Selected high-field overlap starts were scanned globally; low offsets 0..0x70 only in [0x82680000,0x826D0000). No result cap was used.
scanBoundary.generatedCheck: Every matched displacement and base-register encoding was checked against supported flat words. This validates candidate locators, not base provenance or complete instruction semantics.
scanBoundary.qualification: The untruncated decoded scan missed known D3D fields because function and listing coverage was sparse. Raw candidates include code, data and undefined bytes. None of these counts proves object identity, arbitrary aliases or runtime execution.

dirtyReaders.directModel: All 319 raw ld/ext0 candidates for non-SP offsets 0..0x27 in [0x82680000,0x826D0000) matched generated instructions. Of these, 277 were classified G reads, 9 other fields and 33 unresolved aliases. Nine accepted inline dirty writers added 24 G reads. Partial-width, indexed and bulk forms were not closed.
dirtyReaders.localTransfers: The 277 surviving classified G reads contained 210 local OR and 2 shader-metadata ANDC transfers plus 65 kept flush-chain reads. SetPixelShader reads G+0x8 at 0x82692A00 and stores its ANDC at 0x82692A0C; SetVertexShader reads G+0x0 at 0x82692D10 and stores its ANDC at 0x82692D1C. Old dirty values did not select a local branch or API result before these same-field transfers.

retainedFamilies.role: diagnostic capture that applies only when a condition holds

dirtyReaders.use: These families test and mask G+0x10/+0x18/+0x20, invoke shared emission helpers and clear selected groups. ACC60 writes the resulting G+0x30 at 0x826ACD14 and may enter a command-space slow path. Extra emission alone does not prove an observable API-result difference or prove equivalent redundant work.
dirtyReaders.boundedOmissionCandidates: G+0x0/+0x8 have only local OR and ANDC surviving reads in this direct and API model. G+0x18 kept emission uses mask 0x007FFFFC00000000, bits 34..54, excluding low32 fetch bits. These are local projection results, not universal never-clear policies.
dirtyReaders.qualification: Whole-qword sticky equivalence remains unresolved. Close partial-width or alias readers, ACFF8 tail or indirect entry points and kept cursor and allocation consequences before selecting it.

exactCpuNibble.condition: r5==0 selects G+0x2884; other values select indexed render-state words. Resolve reaches the helper at 0x8269E8DC when flags include 0x100, with the selected local control word's low three bits as r5.
exactCpuNibble.use: The selected format nibble at bits 16..19 drives CPU table and helper selection and G+0x2A30/+0x2A34 writes. Preserve the exact mode-folded nibble for this kept path.
exactCpuNibble.setterQualification: Setter 0x8268E908 reads G+0x2884 at 0x8268E98C but masks out its old nibble before merging a new one. That RMW alone does not require the old nibble.

modeReaders.rebasedPayload: Clear at 0x826A24B0 and Resolve at 0x8269E9D4 pass G+0x2920 to ACC60; mask 0x1F000 selects five contiguous words. ACC60 rebases the pointer and loads at 0x826ACCF8, with AC610 providing the slow copy path. This includes G+0x2924/+0x2928 despite their direct-load negatives. Similar kept families pass G+0x2880 and the same G+0x2920 block. Loaded values were payload-only in these inspected copy paths; existing host consumers remain separate obligations.
modeReaders.controlEffects: G+0x2940 is passed by Clear 0x826A2464 and Resolve 0x8269E988 to AC8C8; bit 0 can change CPU command-construction branching and cursor length, while low bit 1 was payload-only in the inspected paths. Resolve tests G+0x2ABE mask 0x08 at 0x8269ECE0 and clears it at 0x8269ED20 after its selected synchronization sequence. Omission needs an explicit cursor and helper equivalence contract.
modeReaders.bitPrecision: AC6C8 changes G+0x2940 bits 0/1 and G+0x2ABD mask 0x04, not mask 0x10. Render-state getters return other G+0x2940 bits or byte G+0x2942. Present's G+0x2ABE mask 0x10 test does not read the draw-written0x08/0x40/0x80 values.
modeReaders.boundedDeadCandidates: No kept direct G-derived reader of G+0x2954/+0x319C was identified. Inspected kept direct uses allowed stale G+0x2ABD mask 0x04 and G+0x2ABE masks 0x40/0x80. Arbitrary aliases and raw-only candidates remain unresolved.
modeReaders.qualification: Neither a fullword load nor a preserved unrelated flag proves all bits observable. Payload-only copies do not by themselves require exact values when payload is discarded. They also do not prove complete omission safe.

persistentReaders.layout: R_v=VS+0x1A0*v. Declaration tag=VD+0x30; variant tag=R_v+0x28; stride qwords=R_v+0x30/+0x38; variant fence stamp=R_v+0x40; saved source fetch records start atR_v+0x44. Literal VS+0x48..0x63 overlaps saved records, not the stride cache.
persistentReaders.cachedStride: SetStreamSource 0x8268FB08 forms G+stream and reads byte G+0x2E38+stream at 0x8268FC08 when full unsigned stride>>2 is nonzero. Comparison inequality ORs dirty 0x80000. Exact cached bytes preserve the branch; stale bytes require a proved redundant-dirty protocol. The two UP comparison readers are consumed.

cpuCodeCopy.condition: A nonnull destination selects the copy arm; null only reports metadata-plus-code size.
cpuCodeCopy.use: Load C=word(VS+0x20), M=word(VS+0x36C), S=word(VS+0x370), then request a copy of S code bytes from C to destination+M after copying metadata from VS+0x368. This reads the persistent code allocation patched by the consumed selector.
cpuCodeCopy.callerClosure: 0x82662D28 calls 0x82694480 at 0x82662D60 for size and 0x82662DF8 for the nonnull copy. Its owner-derived shader record supplies resource+4 and buffer+8. On device mismatch it releases the resource and calls 0x825E0248 to recreate it from the preserved buffer. Direct upstream clients call 0x82662D28 at 0x825E1D2C and 0x8265E26C after record+0x14 bit 0x80000000 and nonnull-resource tests.
cpuCodeCopy.obligation: Preserve the exact requested code bytes for a kept readback of the patched resource, or provide an equivalent readback contract. Consuming draw entries alone does not eliminate this CPU reader.
cpuCodeCopy.qualification: Actual ordered identity with a previously patched VS, optional buffer vtable+0xC targets, copy helper effects and ranges remain guarded. No runtime activation, save and reset semantic name or complete set of resource aliases is claimed.

persistentReaders.gettersAndLifetime: GetVertexShader 0x82692E18 returns and AddRefs G+0x3198; GetVertexDeclaration 0x82692E78 returns and AddRefs G+0x2E2C. Their inspected bodies do not read cache prefixes or code. Release 0x826981D8 and type 6 cleanup 0x82697AA8 read resource header+4/+8 and the VS code pointer for freeing, not variant stamp+0x40 or code bytes. Resource header+8 and variant stamp are distinct.
persistentReaders.constructorBoundary: Init 0x82692B50 reads code records and snapshots them at R_v+0x44+12*i. Its sole raw direct caller is CreateVS 0x826946BC after fresh allocation and code copy. It did not establish a kept post-patch use of the initializer.
persistentReaders.boundedDeadCandidates: Identified VD tag, variant tag, stride and stamp, saved fetch record and ID counter readers were inside consumed selector and patcher paths. The readback API excludes the cache prefix. Optional creation callbacks and copied, indexed and bulk aliases keep global absence unresolved.
persistentReaders.counterSearch: Counter 0x82FA0544 had one decoded materializer and one raw 8-word split candidate at 0x826ADD1C/0x826ADD20, zero database xrefs, with caps 256/8 not reached. The atomic increment is at 0x826ADD30/0x826ADD38. Long-distance, copied or indexed aliases are outside that search.

listAndAllocatorReaders.rebasedCursor: EndTiledList 0x826AC218 forms L=G+0x33C0 at 0x826AC2BC and calls 0x8269B508 at 0x826AC2C0. For nonnull L+4, B508 reads L+8=G+0x33C8 at 0x8269B514/0x8269B538, links the tail and writes the terminator through that cursor. Direct G+0x33C8 negatives therefore do not establish deadness.
listAndAllocatorReaders.listGrowth: 0x8269C170 reads L+8 at 0x8269C190/0x8269C1FC and updates the list descriptor through allocation and linking. Kept list initialization, finalization and submission share this protocol. Exact descriptor and record storage or a replacement list contract is needed while those readers survive; the full set of record-byte, replay and reclaim paths remains open.
listAndAllocatorReaders.sharedPools: 0x8269B618 reads G+0x3A44 at 0x8269B634 and G+0x3A4C at 0x8269B6B4/0x8269B780 to select allocation addresses and wrap and wait paths.0x826A6848 reads G+0x3A44 at 0x826A685C and cursor and limits to choose a pointer or failure and lower limits.0x8269B818 reads G+0x3A54 at 0x8269B888 and G+0x3A4C at 0x8269B8B4 for used-byte accounting and threshold cursor and limit writes.
listAndAllocatorReaders.snapshot: 0x8269B0E0 snapshots G+0x30/+0x34 and G+0x3A4C/+0x3A44 at 0x8269B0E0/0x8269B0E4/0x8269B0EC/0x8269B0F0; kept BeginTiledList calls it at 0x826AC0C8. 0x8269B118 restores the saved pool and cursor words.
listAndAllocatorReaders.dirtyAllocationFrontier: Skipped dirty emission can change G+0x30 and command-space paths before allocation. B618's zero-cursor alternatives and A6848's collision test consume shared cursor and limits. Entry-only arithmetic does not close newly allowed dirty allocation, manager, wait, growth, threshold or failure paths.
listAndAllocatorReaders.qualification: Preserve exact shared-pool behavior on the allowed paths or replace its observable allocation contract. The low-offset cursor inventory includes other-object collisions; it is not complete G provenance. Returned scratch extents, existing host staging and post-commit lifetime remain governed by the completion contract.

endStateReaderBoundary.question: Which parts of the selected reader partition remain after a complete current draw, control and ring consume cut, and which native source paths reconstruct effective state?
endStateReaderBoundary.notation: W/Q/B denote BE32/BE64/byte reads. G is the preserved device; offsets and masks are hexadecimal. Effective native state and persistent guest history are distinct obligations.
endStateReaderBoundary.qualification: A partition that holds only under its stated conditions, not a universal dead-state set or a consume allowance. Positive guest links below reuse accepted evidence; the current-cut and native-overwrite distinctions are source-bound refinements. Direct-reader absence within the inspected scope, raw snapshots and dirty-only transfers do not prove semantic need or global omission safety.

cutDefinitions.currentCut: [source] Every reached invocation at a currently consume-capable entry and call site takes its published success path, with no Original at that boundary. This preserves helper calls made by successful replacements. route_entries.inc is instrumentation, not a consume manifest. guest_api_hooks.cpp:13-52 consumes only Clear and SetPredication, while other API setters, getters, creators, Release, reset and title code retain their bodies. Direct sink 0x826A2B58, AutomaticIndex 0x826A3608, shader patch 0x826AD150 and commit 0x826A2FF0 remain unconditional Original at the pin. Begin, worker and token, and the entry points of kept helpers, are separate. The VdSwap cut is call site 0x826A4884, not the whole 0x826A4638 CPU tail.
cutDefinitions.widerCut: [unproved] A prospective complete draw, helper and tiling replacement could remove additional selector, emitter, staging and worker invocations only by replacing their observable effects and all kept entry points. It still retains title and effect code, resource identity, readback and recreation, API setters, getters, creation, Release and reset, and the code that holds, replaces and releases native rendering and progress state. No complete API replacement is implied.

endStateReaderBoundary.nativeInputTiming: [source] NativeDrawScope precedes Original or consume at rerevved:src/gpu/guest_d3d/draw_hooks.cpp:63,127,185. Entry shadow reads are surviving input and history consumers, not proof that post-ADD88 stores must be exposed to the same already-captured draw. Native code that holds, replaces and releases the effective state may reconstruct that draw; later roots and kept APIs still need their own history contract.
sourceReadersAndOverwrites: [source] indexed_buffer_consume.cpp:156,185,255-273 reads selector tags and key, mode low3 and effective dirty and stride for the current allow decision. These are removable implementation checks under a wider proved replacement, not permanent renderer requirements by themselves. A raw device snapshot similarly proves no individual word semantically required.

[source] C=W(G+0x2954) maps to register 0x2208, whose mode 4/5 values affect native gameplay recipe decisions at src/gpu/d3d12/native_gameplay_draw.cpp:607,741. Derived W(G+0x2920/+0x2924/+0x2928) map to 0x2180/81/82 and program, context and interpolator recipe checks at:614. These are effective native-input contracts; they do not force persistence of an old guest word on every path.

[source] Successful non-codeOnly FoldSolidShaderMetadata overwrites C low3 with 4 and all three 2920/24/28 shadows at solid_draw_adapter.cpp:774-781. CodeOnly returns before those stores. Depth-only folding at scene_draw_adapter.cpp:1157-1177 preserves some old state when dirty 1E0000 is absent; it writes 2920/24 only when dirty 180000 and does not overwrite 2928. Therefore the successful PS-fold overwrite cannot be generalized to all surviving native routes.

[source] Native initial-clear validation at src/gpu/d3d12/native_menu_draw.cpp:331 checks register 0x2203 against 0x15/0x05; source mapping covers W(G+0x2940). This is a selected allow predicate, not proof that all native rendering permanently needs draw-changed HiZ low bits. resolve_derive.cpp:347 uses only bit 5 and byte 2942, so that read does not prove bits 0/1 needed.

[static] The kept SetStreamSource cached-byte comparison is dirty-producing; its existence alone does not prove a changed render result if a complete redundant-dirty and allow-check protocol replaces downstream effects. The known persistent-code CPU readback and recreation path is a positive payload observation and remains separately governed by native-renderer-shader-readback-activation. Resource-header fences and variant stamps stay distinct.

[static] Rebased list and shared-pool readers and kept helper, progress and lifetime effects remain under currentEvidence/listAndAllocatorReaders and native-renderer-d3d-completion-contract. No-Original at a parent hook does not remove helper calls made by its replacement. Byte04/G319C/cache-prefix/counter direct-reader negatives retain their exact scan and alias limits.
endStateReaderBoundary.guardReductionBoundary: [static] Ordinary and no-fetch positive branch exclusions and exact guard-or-replay formulas are defined in native-renderer-dirty-up-helper-contract reachedOrdinaryUp. They shrink selected invocation obligations without proving a whole field family dead. [unproved] Replacing scalar equalities by replay requires preflight, original store order, alias handling, preserved values and immutable native-input agreement, plus all pressure and allocation outcomes. Retiring native allow predicates or guest packet readers alone does not establish that every effective-state, API or generation-specific readback contract is replaced.
endStateReaderBoundary.falsificationCondition: A reader outside the declared cut, changed source mapping or overwrite precondition, codeOnly or depth-only path incorrectly treated as an unconditional overwrite, stale preserved history, or an aliased or indirect reader invalidates omission inferred from this partition. Current-cut success, actual root activation and runtime parity remain not yet established.

nextDiscriminator: Close the explicit unclassified dirty aliases, partial-width, indexed or bulk overlaps, escaped getter-created object aliases and raw-only code and data candidates before an exhaustive reader-absence claim.
Tie the kept command discard, cursor, helper and allocator observations to concrete masks and inputs before claiming whole dirty-qword or derived-flag stale equivalence.
Tie a kept CPU readback to its ordered resource identity and its buffer and copy targets, or implement an equivalent readback bridge before omitting patched guest code.
Close tail or indirect patcher and constant-flush entry points, counter aliases, full tile-record decoder and reclaim and actual dirty allocation paths before broadening what is allowed.
guards: Do not call surviving dirty readers OR-only, or infer whole-qword sticky equivalence from local same-field transfers.
Do not call patched VS code GPU-only; a surviving CPU code-copy path is identified, as is a recreation path that applies only when a condition holds.
Do not conflate decimal 40/48/64 with hexadecimal offsets 0x40/0x48/0x64, resource-header fences with variant stamps, or flag mask 0x04 with bit index 4.
Do not equate direct-load absence with rebased, indexed, copied or bulk reader absence.
Do not infer runtime activation, complete API cut equivalence, which code holds, replaces and releases the allocator, scratch lifetime or safe consume allowance from this static result.
conclusion: The draw-only cut retains a CPU shader-code copy and recreation path, exact Resolve color-format nibble use, cached-stride comparison, masked dirty flushes and rebased list and shared-pool readers. Some cache-prefix, flag and dirty-bit writes are omission candidates within the inspected scope, but the full set of readers and observations remains unresolved.
